rationale: DEV2.0-0.6B (m4-t-a7-soup: official Qwen3-0.6B-Base fully fine-tuned, three-seed uniform soup) clearly beats its own Decision 1.0 (Kai) on post-key same-panel JevArena v3 (43.54 vs 35.94, +7.60 [+4.70, +10.76]) and clears the tier threshold (>= 38.3, 90% of GLiNER2.5-Decide 42.52). It is level with the tier leader GLiNER2.5-Decide (+1.02 [-1.77, +7.80]), with human transfer not below it (+0.039 [-0.013, +0.167]) and significantly above Bosun v3.1 0.6B (+0.137 [+0.010, +0.192]); no decision type collapsed. The sealed, independent JevArena-C1 event 2 confirms the gain over Kai 1.0 (33.21 vs 17.77, +15.44 [+13.51, +17.21]; every type interval above 0), with the caveat that Kai runs at its published 1,024-token limit and 525 of 2,874 items it cannot take count as wrong (on the 11 tasks that fit, 29.4 vs 20.3, point estimate). It is level with Bosun on C1 (-1.82 [-4.05, +0.35]). Calibration ships T = 1 under the 23:15 rule. The package is the frozen scored checkpoint, verified end to end, and every regression is disclosed on the card.
